title: MikroTik Site Switch and AP Operations
description: Operational knowledge base for the MikroTik devices behind SMC boxes (RB450Gx4 site switch, Metal 52 ac AP on rct sites): read-only RouterOS access through a Teleport port-forward, port and VLAN layout, uptime/voltage/link-down health, TSTIK power-cycle evidence, fleet surveys and outage diagnosis. Complements skill-smc (SMC box, ansible-wifi, TSTIK app) and skill-cambium (Cambium devices).
scope_boundary: In scope: MikroTik/RouterOS devices at SMC sites, their access method, layout, health, logs, failure signatures and read-only tooling. Out of scope: the SMC box, Ansible, Teleport and the TSTIK app (skill-smc); Cambium devices (skill-cambium). Changes to devices are out of scope unless the operator approves a specific change.
known_constraints: Devices are reachable only through the site SMC; no secret may appear in a command run on the SMC (Teleport audit log ships to Graylog).
The RouterOS log is an in-memory buffer lost on device reboot; capture before any power-cycle.
Read-only by default; mikrotik_exec.sh refuses non-read commands unless MT_ALLOW_WRITE=1.
stable_facts: rct site switch: RB450Gx4 at 10.255.0.5; AP: Metal 52 ac at 10.255.0.20; both RouterOS 7.8 where surveyed (2026-10-07).
Switch ether1 is the trunk to the SMC eth0 (VLANs 500/501/521/522 tagged, untagged bridged with ether2, the Sky Muster NTD, into bridge-vlan521).
The SMC's TSTIK app power-cycles the switch rail after ~11 minutes of failed switch/AP pings (skill-smc 06_failure-modes.md).
